title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Lesson 48 ]

items.text: If I had enough money, I would buy you a diamond ring.
alternatives: Had I enough money, I would buy you a diamond ring.

items.text: If I had known your phone number, I would have called you.
alternatives: Had I known your phone number, I would have called you.
If I had known your phone number, I would have given you a ring.
If I had known your phone number, I would have given you a call.

items.text: I wish I had a room reserved for tonight.
I wish I hadn't got a ticket for running a red light.
I wish this were not a formal party.
The missile could have handed Argentina victory in the war.
If they had had the ability to make money, they would have had food and clothing.
alternatives: Had they had the ability to make money, they would have had food and clothing.
If they had had the ability to make money, they would have had food and clothes.

items.text: He would be in high school now if he had not flunked a grade.
alternatives: Had he not flunked a grade, he would be in high school now.

items.text: If the blood products had been heat-treated, they could not have been infected with HIV.
alternatives: Had the blood products been heat-treated, they could not have been infected with HIV.
If the blood products had been heat treated, they could not have been infected with HIV.

items.text: I should have known you were lying.
If only I hadn't promised him.
Were it not for the sun, nothing could live.
alternatives: If it were not for the sun, nothing could live.

items.text: Had I been three minutes late, I would have missed the train.
alternatives: If I had been three minutes late, I would have missed the train.
If I had been three minutes late, I should have missed the train.
Had I been three minutes late, I should have missed the train.
Had I been 3 minutes late, I would have missed the train.
If I had been 3 minutes late, I would have missed the train.

items.text: Should you not go, he would go.
alternatives: If you should not go, he would go.
Should you not go, he will go.
If you don't go, he will go.
